title: codeboost review answer
description: The problems one review round found, written by the review agent (prompts/review.md). Strict-mode compatible: every object lists all its properties as required and allows no others; optional values are nullable. There is no $schema line on purpose: Claude Code's --json-schema rejects the draft 2020-12 URL. Validate with a draft 2020-12 validator.

round.description: The review round this answer is for, copied from the task data.

problems.description: Every problem this round found. An empty list means the round found nothing.

items.description: The plan items whose code must change to fix this problem. codeboost files one copy of the problem against each.

detail.description: Where it is (file and line) and why it is wrong, so that a fix needs no other context.

check.description: The text of the check entry this problem fails, copied exactly, or null when it fails the item's intent only.
